title: Emotional coherence test suite
description:
Create tests/test_emotional.py with pytest tests covering the emotional intelligence modules from tasks k.1–k.7.

Tests to include:
- test_mood_engine_default: default_state() returns warm/neutral baseline
- test_mood_engine_update_delta_bounds: energy change per turn <= 0.05, closeness <= 0.03
- test_mood_engine_prompt_hints: to_prompt_hints() returns non-empty string with mood/energy context
- test_user_state_infer_confidence_cap: confidence never exceeds 0.6
- test_user_state_infer_empty_input: returns UserState with low confidence when given no messages
- test_user_state_is_stable: is_stable() returns True after 5+ inferences with stable confidence
- test_mode_selector_default: returns NORMAL for empty/neutral input
- test_mode_selector_triggers: verify specific user states trigger correct modes (tired->BEDTIME, frustrated->VENTING, playful->PLAYFUL)
- test_mode_selector_prompt_hints: to_prompt_hints() returns non-empty mode-specific string
- test_mode_selector_response_params: get_response_params() returns expected dict keys for each mode
- test_persona_prompt_backward_compat: calling persona prompt builder without mood/mode produces same output as before
- test_persona_prompt_mood_injection: mood hints appear in prompt when mood is provided
- test_persona_prompt_mode_injection: mode hints appear in prompt when mode is provided
- test_models_emotional_columns: verify chatbot.db.models.Session has mood_state, user_state, conversation_mode columns
- test_models_log_tables: verify BotMoodLog and UserStateLog are importable and have expected columns
- test_migration_0002_reversible: parse 0002_emotional_state.py and confirm upgrade() and downgrade() exist

Do not require a running Postgres instance. Tests should use in-memory constructs where possible. Skip live-DB tests with pytest.mark.skipif.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task k.8)
- chatbot/soul/mood.py (produced by task k.1)
- chatbot/soul/user_state.py (produced by task k.2)
- chatbot/soul/modes.py (produced by task k.3)
- chatbot/db/models.py (updated by task k.4)
- migrations/versions/0002_emotional_state.py (produced by task k.5)
- chatbot/soul/persona_prompt.py (updated by task k.6)
- chatbot/core/turn.py (updated by task k.7)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.
